sourceAssessment.mechanics: ApplyLifecycleReduction returns its already obtained result and existing transition ID; no extra AdvanceLifetime, effect/resource reduction, identity allocation or processed-history insertion is introduced. Failed execution still prevents a returned completed plan/ledger. Other consuming-use callers ignore the new observation and preserve their original behavior.
sourceAssessment.ownership: Only the private planner issuer creates/extends the ledger. Each initial execution owns a private reference token, retained through final completion. MatchesInitialPlan checks that token as well as exact initial payload, so a separately executed identical plan cannot match. This is warm execution evidence, not publication/source authority or cold authentication.
sourceAssessment.immutability: JSON is deeply detached on construction/export/extension; bound ledger state has no mutator. DetachedCopyOf preserves the same immutable evidence only when its legacy payload is unchanged. Appending final evidence requires the private issuer and an initial one-pass ledger. A missing initial ledger stays null on common completion instead of being synthesized.
sourceAssessment.payloadAndRecovery: Ledger fingerprint has a separate domain/version and references the existing acyclic legacy payload. WoundAcceptedTurnPlan fingerprint grammar is byte-unchanged and does not read the ledger. New constructor-time recovery fingerprint read is safe: GetMortalRecoveryExecutionFingerprint reads only immutable Fingerprint initialized by the proof constructor; Seal later sets a separate payload binding. No new recovery seal/permission is issued by the read.
sourceAssessment.retainedC: Production Pc calculation/retention/cache code is unchanged; completed Effects naturally retains the ledger. The changed genuine integration assertion runs only after all old actual flow/union/charge/progression/story/turn/replay/strict cleanup, checks exact same C/effect result, complete ledger and private initial execution against the actual retained calculation inputs; exports diagnostic JSON and fingerprint.
sourceAssessment.fixtures: Initial three causal cases retain all success preconditions. Ten additional independent actual-common scenarios cover turns expiry, causal-created/uses exclusions, active/expired source-bound, until_time/null, NPC advance, source order plus within-pass state change, no source events, and two distinct targets. Passive characteristic modifiers avoid resource side effects; source definitions/targets/carriers/identity rows match actual validation contracts. Uses case deliberately has no matching consuming event, so it proves the lifetime skip only; selected actual continuation covers true consuming-use expiry.
